description.narrative:

description.narrative: Number of digital devices available to be used by NBS census staff for the 2024 conducting of population and housing census Digital devices

comment.narrative: Following the Pilot Census the National Bureau of Statistics estimated that 4720 tablets would be needed for successful data collection in the 2024 Population and Housing Census. Initially the project planned to procure 2500 tablets but at the request of the National Bureau of Statistics this number was increased to 3000 tablets with the additional 1720 tablets being funded by the state budget. The technical specifications for the tablets were developed in accordance with the requirements of the data collection software and were approved by the eGovernance Agency and UNFPA Information Technology Solutions Office. The procurement of the 3000 tablets and necessary accessories was conducted following UNFPA Procurement Procedures and received additional approval from the eGovernance Agency of the Republic of Moldova.

comment.narrative: 70 persons heads deputy heads census managers from the Center North South and Chisinau municipality regional statistical centers CRS strengthened the knowledge and capacities of the supervisory census staff in the organization and conduction of the Pilot Census. In the 26 February 16 March 2024 period 200 people participated in the first stage of training the participants were distributed in 4 groups corresponding to each statistical region municipality of Chisinau Center North South the training duration of each group being 5 days. The participants strengthened their capacities and skills regarding the legislative methodological and technical aspects regarding the Population and Housing Census. The supervisory staff engaged in the 2024 Population and Housing Census had a four days training in the period 2023 March 2024. A total number of 557 supervisors increased their knowledge about the Census process including preenumeration enumeration and postenumeration stages of the census.

comment.narrative: The National Bureau of Statistics NBS conducted a Pilot Population and Housing Census Pilot Census from 28 August 2023 to 10 October 2023 in ten localities across the Republic of Moldova. The localities where the Pilot Census was conducted were geographically distributed to cover the regions of North Center South UTA Gagauzia and Chisinau municipality. The localities from the North region Municipality of Balti and Soroca and Glinjeni village. The localities from the South region City of Taraclia and Crihana Veche village. The localities from the Center region Varnita Butuceni and Copanca villages. In the Chisinau municipality the Pilot census was conducted in the Botanica Ciocana Center and Riscani districts and in the Colonita village. The tested data collection method was CAPI Computer Assisted Personal Interview.

title.narrative: Number of census software developed, tested and ready to be used by NBS for the 2024 population and housing census

description.narrative: Number of census software developed, tested and ready to be used by NBS for the 2024 population and housing census

comment.narrative: The software for field data collection was developed based on the Census and Survey Processing System CS Pro software package developed by the U.S. Census Bureau. The data collection software was developed in line with the approved questionnaires for 2024 Census 1. Household questionnaire 2. Collective living space questionnaire 3. Individual questionnaire and in line with the Technical Specifications Document for the development of the Population and Housing Census Information System as a part of the Social and Demographic Statistics informational system approved by the eGovernance Agency of Republic of Moldova and National Bureau of Statistics. The software for field data collection incorporated the GIS component as well which collected geographical information x y coordinates to ensure the georeferenced data collection.
